scope.math: original saved integer confusions and object mean-point errors; NumPy calculations independently written, no producer/helper imports

boundaries: All results are the exposed dev200/100scene endpoint of one training seed11, not full5119 or an unseen test.
Intervals resample whole scenes while preserving natural within-scene anchor/object counts. They are unadjusted and do not include training-seed uncertainty.
Cpl/Fix and original O may have different t0 predictions because the native head was trained; transition changes do not isolate future motion.
No O native flow exists; physical comparisons use D, CRN_CV and zero on rigid-box virtual material-point targets.
Improvement over D can be inherited from the already stronger CRN-CV base. Cpl versus Fix identifies this matched learned-spatial-address edge, not all possible motion-occupancy connections.
Actual final tensor checks were performed by the producer and authenticated here; this independent audit did not load or recompute tensor weights/gradients/optimizer moments.
